description: This file defines the 'FeatureCreated' event class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models an event emitted after a feature is created on a thing, including constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and related metadata.

classes.name: FeatureCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of a feature on a thing, capable of JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing access to feature details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of FeatureCreated with various parameter combinations, including from JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureCreated instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the created Feature associated with this event.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the feature to JSON according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for this feature within the entity.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends feature data to JSON payload for serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the object state.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
